p.write_text('def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    major = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    minor = next(x for x in counts if x != major)
    return [[minor if x == major else 0 for x in row] for row in grid]
')
